query_text: Does it matter what we eat?

outputs.content:
Yes, what we eat matters a great deal. Our diet has a profound impact on our physical health, mental well-being, energy levels, and even the environment. Eating a balanced diet rich in fruits, vegetables, whole grains, lean proteins, and healthy fats can help prevent chronic diseases, maintain a healthy weight, and support overall vitality. On the other hand, poor dietary choices can lead to health issues like obesity, diabetes, heart disease, and nutritional deficiencies.

Additionally, food choices can affect mood, cognitive function, and longevity. There’s also growing awareness of how our food choices impact the planet—such as the carbon footprint of different foods and the sustainability of agricultural practices.
